hook_text: Look up on a clear night in the Karoo and you can see thousands of stars. Where is the Earth in all of that?
clip_script: Sutherland, in the Karoo. No city lights. You look up, and the sky explodes with stars. That pale cloudy band? The Milky Way: billions of stars. That kite shape? The Southern Cross. And you are standing on a planet, a blue ball floating in space. Every star you see is a sun, so far away it looks like a dot. Our Sun is just the closest one. Welcome to your address in space.
visual_style: Whiteboard night sky over a Karoo farmhouse, the Milky Way drawn as a pale band, the Southern Cross and its two Pointer stars marked, then a small blue Earth floating in black space with the Sun and Moon nearby.
mood: Quiet and full of wonder, like lying on a blanket under the stars.
pacing: From the daytime sky, to the night sky, to the Earth seen as one planet floating in space.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and find the Southern Cross on the next clear night.
